payer_source.locator: Claims Processing Manual ch29 §310.1.B.2–3; identifiers in supporting records
payer_source.rule: Specific service dates are required information for a written redetermination request; accompanying records may supply identifying information missing from the request form. Beneficiary-specific incomplete-request handling is distinct from this provider-party task.

data.local_policy: This office releases final redetermination packets in provider-party capacity with the request and listed attachments. Administrative identifiers may be contained in accompanying records. Staff may transcribe supported identifiers but do not originate missing claim facts.

payer_source.locator: Ch29 §270.1.5 continuing appointment; §310.1.B.4 duplicate completed requests
payer_source.rule: An appointment can continue through administrative appeals when the appeal was initiated during its one-year initiation period. Re-sending a completed redetermination is not a new valid redetermination request.

data.local_policy: The worklist records the authorized representative and the MAC supplemental-evidence request. This packet is authorized only through that representative capacity. Other filing capacities or a new appeal are separate assignments. The transmission appeal_id is the existing appeal identifier; the supplemental packet_id identifies documents.

handoff_requirement: Compare appointment completion with original 2025-05-01 initiation; explain that initiation was outside this appointment year and request representative/appeals-team authority review or cure before supplementing under that route. Do not label a valid continuing appointment expired merely because today is later.
